tei:div.tei:p: 439) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rdo rje phag mo'i gsang sgrub pad+ma'i rgya can yang zab snying po gcig dril bzhugs: 440) (Dakini secret letter here) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi: snying po yang zab yan ngag ni: blangs te gsang ba'i gdams pa bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: (Dakini secret letter here) dben zhing dga' ba'i gnas mchog tu: spros bcas 'od gsal sgron me ltar: ji bzhin ma nor sgrub la brtson: spros med yang zab snying po ni: chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab brgyad dbus: thabs shes gsang rdzas rdor dril ni: da la'i dbus bzhugs mchod rdzas bshams: rnal 'byor bag phebs dad spro yis: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed ni: na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum kun 'dus rnal 'byor mar: bdag sogs sgo gsum gus 441)pas skyabs su mchi: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: bla med dkyil 'khor bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum gyis rang rgyud sbyangs: sa ma ya: de nas dngos gzhi lha yi sa ma dhi: (Dakini secret letter here) a a aḥ bsam brjod bral ba chos nyid de bzhin nyid: thugs rje ma 'gags rang byung kun tu snang: rtsal snang 'gag med 'od lnga'i klong dkyil du: 'byung lnga rnam dag yum chen lnga yi dbyings: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang chen po: tshad dang mtshan nyid ma lus yongs su rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla zung 'jug steng: rang rig bām̐ 442)dmar yongs su gyur pa las: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje phag mo ni: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum ldan: phyag gnyis g.yas pas gri gug mkha' la phyar: dpa' bo dpa' mo'i thugs rgyud dbyings nas bskul: g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang thugs kar 'dzin: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus char ltar 'bebs: dbu skra kham ser gyen 'khyil spyi bo'i gtsug:

phag zhal nag po'i ngur sgras stong gsum gang: thod skam lnga yi dbu brgyan rtse bran mdzes: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal rin chen spras: gzig sham smad dkris zhabs gnyis g.yas bskums shing: g.yon brkyangs baṃ ro dmar ser gdan la bzhugs: sku la rgyud sde'i lha tshogs ma lus rdzogs: gnas lnga mkha' 'gro lnga yi dal du shar: rtsa gnas rlung thig dpa' bo dpa' mo'i grong: rang byung bde ba chen po'i klong du rdzogs: khro mo'i chas rdzogs khro 'dzum sgeg nyams ldan: gsang ba'i dpa' bo rta mgrin he ru ka: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril 443)spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs: dbu gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher: gar dgu'i nyams ldan khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs: zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskums yum gyi sku la 'khril: yab yum gnyis med ye shes me klong bzhugs: phyi rim phag mo sde lnga rang mdog 'chang: rang rang rigs kyi yab dang gnyis med 'khril: rgyan dang cha lugs rnam 'gyur du ma sogs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por lhun gyis grub: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od 'phros sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs ma lus kun: rdo rje phag mo'i rnam par spyan 'dren no: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med ro gcig gyur: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod nas pad skor 'khyud rgya dang bca' 'di skad do: oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharma yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ: lan gsum brjod: de nas spyan 'dren spos rol bcas: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do: pheṃ: rang gi snying ga'i bām̐ yig 'od zer 'phros pa yis: 'og min gsang ba 444) mchog gi zhing khams chen po nas: rje btsun rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor dbang phyug ma: yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa ma lus thams cad kun:

gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: dbang dang dngos grub ma lus stsol phyir gshegs su gsol: byin rlabs ye shes char chen 'bebs phyir gshegs su gsol: stong gsal brjod med rig pa'i rang zhal sprad du gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'bad med lhun grub stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐ ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ pheṃ pheṃḥ hriṃ hriṃ ā be sha ya s+t+wam̐: de nas bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: ka dag skye med dbyings kyi ngang: lhun grub ye shes ma 'gags pa'i: thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i yum: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas lha phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i gsang gsum 'dzin: yon tan lhun rdzogs rnal 'byor ma: rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo la: rang zhal mjal phyir phyag bgyi'o: na mo 445)pū ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang dang srid pa thams cad kun: kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin: phyi nang mchod pa bsam mi khyab: sman gtor rak+ta gsang mchod tshogs: bla med dkyil 'khor gtso mo mchog: rgyal yum lha la 'bul gyis bzhes: mchog thun su kha'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni badz+ra bha ra hi sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta gu h+ya dzñā na sarba pañtsa khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hrīḥ gsung gi dbang phyug pad+ma rigs kyi lha: so sor rtogs pa'i chags bral ye shes bskyed:sa mi shigs thig le shes rab zab gsal mkha': stong dbyings rdo rje btsun mo'i sku la bstod: gsung gsang mi zad yan lag drug cur ldan: grags stong skye 'gags bral ba nā da'i sgra: 'gags med gsung gsang chos nyid rang sgra che: rig stong rdo rje phag mo'i gsung la bstod: thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das:

ka dag zang thal spros pa'i mtha' brgyad bral: rdo rje 446)bdun ldan chos sku skye ba med: rdo rje btsun mo'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas bshags pa ni: hoḥ gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: lha sngags ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum bag med ci bsags pa: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya= sogs: āḥ de nas 'dzab dgongs ni: hrīḥ rang nyid dbang chen yab yum gyi: thugs kar nyi zla'i gwa'u'i dbus: rang rang srog yig sa bon mthar: sngags phreng g.yas g.yon 'khor ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur bsdus sngags phreng nyid la thim: 'khor 'das srid gsum dbang du rol: snang ba lha dang grags pa sngags: dran rtog chos nyid chen po'i ngang: dag pa rab 'byams la bzla'o: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi h+ya gṝ wa hrīḥbaṃ ha ri ni sa dzaḥsarba sid+dhi sid+dhi pha la pha la hūm̐ āḥ zhes pa ting 'dzin gsal po'i ngang: rlung dang bsres la yid bzlas bya: dus grangs snyen sgrub las sbyor ni: nang sgrub zab mo ltar du bya: rab dngos 447)'bring nyams rmi lam du: thabs grol lam la spyod pa dang: bhan thod mtshan ldan rnyed pa dang: dril bu'i sgra grags dri bzang 'thul: de la sogs pa'i rtags mtshan gsal: gsang zhing gsang bar nyams su longs: dngos grub thob par the tshom med: sa ma ya: e ma: shin tu zab ba'i mthar thug gsang ba'i chos: yang bcud snying po gcig dril khyad du 'phags: ḍā ki yongs kyi thugs bcud zab mo 'di: ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam mthil du zungs: yang gsang bla med snying bcud zab mo'i chos: mkha' spyod myur lam bgrod pa'i gdams pa 'di: ma 'ongs don du rin chen gter du sbos: gtad rgya gnyer byang sngags kyi bdag mor gtod: 'don pa'i dus ni brda byang ji bzhin du: rnal 'byor su kha'i ming dang 'phrad par nges:

gcig brgyud ma gtogs yongs la spel mi rung: spel na mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi chad pa 'byung: skal ldan sems kyi bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta'i 'gro la 'di ma 'phrad: blo dman kha gsag can gyi dbang po snubs: bka' srung sngags bdag lha mos gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor thub par srungs: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer du zungs: sa ma ya: sku rgyaḥ gsung rgya: thugs rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+yaḥ brda thim: 448) (Dakini secret letter here) : ces pa'ang mkha' 'gro'i gsang sgrub zab mo 'di yang dus ring mo nas brda don gsal yang re dogs cung zad skyes nas btang snyoms su yod skabs gsang grogs bī ma la dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ chos kyi bdag po kīrti sogs kyis rin chen gnyis pa dang dbang mdog rin po che'i dar bcas bskul ngor dus mtha'i gter ming su kha badz+ras mkha' 'gro'i brda las dag par phab pa'o// yi ge pa ni kun bzang snang mdzad kyis bgyis pa dge'o// maṅga lam//
